name: order-up
description: A tiny chef pops up on your Mac when a Claude Code session finishes (or needs you) in a tab you're not looking at. Click to jump there.

after.title: Pop up after
after.description: How long a turn must run before a finished one becomes an order

summary.title: Order says
summary.description: What each order says under the project: your prompt shortened (free), a Haiku summary (~$0.001 a turn), or nothing

needsYou.title: Needs you
needsYou.description: Also pop up when a session asks you something or wants a permission

corner.title: Corner
corner.description: Where on the screen the chef stands

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Ring a bell when an order is up

menubar.title: Menu bar chef
menubar.description: A tiny chef in the menu bar: click it to call the chef out and see every session

alwaysOn.title: Menu bar chef when Claude is not running
alwaysOn.description: Keep the menu bar chef even with no Claude session running, and start it at login
